calculation.expression: (-[sum(pct_change(close),5) - cross_asset_mean(sum(pct_change(close),5)]) / rolling_std(pct_change(close),20) when cross_asset_downside_breadth_5d >= 0.60 and cross_asset_mean(rolling_std(pct_change(close),5))/rolling_median_60(cross_asset_mean(rolling_std(pct_change(close),5))) >= 1.15; otherwise null
calculation.description: During broad downside breadth and elevated cross-asset dispersion, fade each instrument's five-day return residual versus the cross-sectional mean, scaled by its 20-day volatility. The signal uses only information through the prior completed session and forecasts subsequent returns.

validation.regime_notes: Positive IC and ICIR across 2020-2022, 2023-2025, and 2026-2031; no observations in the 2030-2032 slice under the active-date filter. Sparse activation warrants overlay use and monitoring.
